items.Sentence: The treatment facilities include a comminutor, Parshall Flume and four unlined treatment ponds.

The septage enters a dewatering station near the headworks, about 500 feet east of the wastewater ponds. A Polymer (polyacrylamide or equal) is added to the septage for dewatering, the supernatant is then discharged to the treatment plant, and after removal from the drying beds the solids delivered to an appropriate disposal facility in Nevada.

The four stabilization ponds operate in series with the flexibility of the influent being discharged into pond No. 1, or into pond No. 2 via a by-pass pipe... Treatment in the ponds consists of natural aeration, and decomposition (after percolating through a shallow soil profile of silts, sands and gravels).
